ex.en: You'd better wear a sweater under your jacket.
ex.zh: 你最好在外套裡面加件毛衣。

ex.en: What do you think of this sweater?
ex.zh: 你覺得這件毛衣怎麼樣？

ex.en: That red sweater looks good on you.
ex.zh: 你穿那件紅毛衣很好看。

ex.en: I swapped a camera for a guitar.
ex.zh: 我用一台相機換了一把吉他。

ex.en: Can we swap seats?
ex.zh: 我們可以換個座位嗎？

ex.en: Let's swap shifts this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末我們換班吧。

ex.en: We arranged a shift swap with our coworkers.
ex.zh: 我們和同事安排了換班。

ex.en: The clothing swap event was a big success.
ex.zh: 換衣活動非常成功。

ex.en: A swallow flies very swiftly.
ex.zh: 燕子飛得非常快。

ex.en: With a glance of her, he left swiftly.
ex.zh: 他看了她一眼，就迅速離開了。

ex.en: The company acted swiftly to fix the problem.
ex.zh: 公司迅速採取行動解決問題。

ex.en: My hands and legs are swollen.
ex.zh: 我的手腳都腫了。

ex.en: How long have your cheeks been swollen?
ex.zh: 你的臉頰腫多久了？

ex.en: Our surplus has swelled by nearly ten percent in this quarter.
ex.zh: 本季我們的盈餘增加了將近一成。

ex.en: The crowd swelled to over 10,000 people.
ex.zh: 人潮增加到一萬多人。

ex.en: I swam very well when I was a child.
ex.zh: 我小時候很會游泳。

ex.en: My younger brother swims every day in the summer.
ex.zh: 我弟弟夏天每天都去游泳。

ex.en: Who is the boy that is swimming over there?
ex.zh: 在那裡游泳的男孩是誰？

ex.en: Let's go for a swim after work.
ex.zh: 下班後我們去游個泳吧。

ex.en: I had a swim in the hotel pool.
ex.zh: 我在飯店的泳池游了泳。

ex.en: Tom and Mary switched places on the bench.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗在長椅上換了位子。

ex.en: Many customers have switched to online banking.
ex.zh: 許多客戶已經改用網路銀行。

switch.zh: switch on / off：打開／關掉（電器）

ex.en: Switch off the light. I can't get to sleep.
ex.zh: 把燈關掉，我睡不著。

ex.en: I was hot, so I switched on the fan.
ex.zh: 我很熱，所以打開了電風扇。

ex.en: I forgot to save the file before switching off.
ex.zh: 我關機前忘了存檔。

ex.en: She groped for the light switch in the dark.
ex.zh: 她在黑暗中摸索電燈開關。

ex.en: The light switch is next to the door.
ex.zh: 電燈開關在門旁邊。

ex.en: The switch to the new system went smoothly.
ex.zh: 換成新系統的過程很順利。

ex.en: She made the switch from sales to marketing.
ex.zh: 她從業務轉調到行銷部門。

ex.en: Those grapes look sweet, but in fact they're sour.
ex.zh: 那些葡萄看起來很甜，其實是酸的。

ex.en: I don't like drinking beverages that are too sweet.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡喝太甜的飲料。

ex.en: When it comes to sweets, I just can't control myself.
ex.zh: 一看到甜食，我就控制不了自己。

ex.en: According to dentists, tooth decay is not always caused by sweets.
ex.zh: 根據牙醫的說法，蛀牙不一定是甜食造成的。

ex.en: It's so sweet of you to remember my birthday.
ex.zh: 你記得我的生日，真貼心。

ex.en: What a sweet little dog!
ex.zh: 好可愛的小狗！

ex.en: Chris swung his sword!
ex.zh: 克里斯揮了一下劍。

ex.en: He swung the bat and hit the ball.
ex.zh: 他揮棒擊中了球。

ex.en: The kids are playing on the swings.
ex.zh: 孩子們在盪鞦韆。

ex.en: There is a swing in our backyard.
ex.zh: 我們後院有一座鞦韆。

ex.en: Mennad always has those mood swings.
ex.zh: 梅納德的情緒總是起伏很大。

ex.en: There was a big swing in oil prices this year.
ex.zh: 今年油價波動很大。

ex.en: My father is sweeping the garage.
ex.zh: 我爸正在掃車庫。

ex.en: Don't forget to sweep the kitchen clean.
ex.zh: 別忘了把廚房掃乾淨。

ex.en: A blast of cold air swept through the house.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風吹過整間房子。

ex.en: Tsunamis swept through rice fields and flooded the towns.
ex.zh: 海嘯席捲稻田，淹沒了城鎮。

ex.en: I swear I will never do such a thing.
ex.zh: 我發誓絕對不會做這種事。

ex.en: The knight swore an oath of allegiance to the king.
ex.zh: 騎士宣誓效忠國王。

ex.en: I swear I didn't tell anyone your secret.
ex.zh: 我發誓我沒把你的秘密告訴任何人。

ex.en: Tom can't go three sentences without swearing.
ex.zh: 湯姆講不到三句話就會罵髒話。

ex.en: Please don't swear in front of the kids.
ex.zh: 請不要在孩子面前罵髒話。

ex.en: I don't have a sword.
ex.zh: 我沒有劍。

ex.en: This sword has a strange history.
ex.zh: 這把劍有一段奇特的歷史。

ex.en: Social media is a double-edged sword.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是一把雙面刃。

ex.en: Fame can be a double-edged sword.
ex.zh: 名氣可能是一把雙面刃。

ex.en: Mary was a switchboard operator when she was younger.
ex.zh: 瑪麗年輕時當過總機接線員。

ex.en: Call the switchboard and ask for the HR department.
ex.zh: 打給總機，請他們轉人資部。
